objections.claim: E6's determinization mechanism is not implementable as specified. A bwrap seccomp-BPF filter cannot synthesize runner-fixed bytes into getrandom/getentropy caller buffers or emulate fixed clock results; it can only filter syscalls unless a separate user-notification supervisor is implemented, and vDSO clock calls can bypass seccomp entirely. No such supervisor or vDSO interception mechanism is specified. Therefore the claimed deterministic exhaustive oracle battery and RANDOM-EXIT/CLOCK-PHASE regressions are unsatisfied, leaving governance correction d unresolved.

The release writer-set closure omits workflow-issued GITHUB_TOKEN credentials. The telos-authority-release environment constrains only jobs that reference it; a substituted off-main workflow can omit the environment and explicitly request contents:write because the repository's read-only default is not a permission ceiling. Main/tag rulesets protect refs, not Release API objects, and the candidate itself acknowledges that contents:write can delete an immutable release. Thus an off-main workflow can mutate drafts or delete published releases whenever Actions is enabled, outside the claimed Eye-local exclusive interval and without appearing in the collaborator/App/deploy-key custody manifest. The substituted-definition, closed-writer-set, and default-suspended acceptance claims are therefore false.
